hcp.scope: RGPH 2024 legal population by region, province/prefecture and commune; not a list of all named settlements.
hcp.freshness: Catalog checked on review date. It includes 2026 thematic publications; the legal population tables remain the 2024 census reference. No claim of a newer exhaustive settlement registry.
hcp.reuse: HCP site terms permit reuse with attribution, integrity, disclosure of modifications and no implied endorsement. Nine municipal records and 20 alias mappings were adapted with source-page references in location-corrections.json.

oncf.evidence: Atlas guide (2018), page 5: station-level corridor map, including Rabat Ville, Sidi Yahia and Ain Taoujdat. ESG 2024 page 17: schematic network with city-level Rabat/Casablanca, insufficient to disambiguate their stations. Al Boraq destinations explicitly identifies Casa Voyageurs, Rabat Agdal, Kenitra and Tanger. Sources provide historical geographic context, not validation of current services or simulator timings.
oncf.access: Direct web-tool fetches timed out; the guide and ESG PDF were successfully downloaded locally and their maps visually inspected. Official destination search-index content was available. No current schedules/prices were imported.

osm.usage: Policy examined. No OSM data or public Nominatim autocomplete is used; no ODbL-derived dataset was added.

presentation: Station display names are editorial localizations of the existing registry, not additional operator-certified station names. Canonical names/IDs and QR payload remain unchanged. Geographic Arabic names use source aliases only, with source spelling as fallback.
